name: Outreach CRM — Reply Staleness Alert
description: Runs every 30 min during business hours (8am–7pm weekdays). Finds replies received today that haven't been responded to in 2+ hours and sends an urgent alert. Never sends outreach emails.

nodes.name: Schedule: Every 30min (8am–7pm Weekdays)

nodes.name: Send Urgency Alert to Yourself
nodes.notes: Sends ONLY to you. Never contacts leads.

nodes.name: No Stale Replies — Silent End
nodes.notes: Runs silently every 30 min when nothing needs attention. No email sent.

meta.note: Runs every 30 minutes. Silent when no alerts needed. Fires urgency email the moment a reply goes 2h without response during business hours.
